irregularities.title: ESPN volleyball is college-only; OLBG's open card is EuroVolley
irregularities.detail: On 2026-09-02 the OLBG Volleyball/21 index listed Poland W vs Netherlands W and Germany W vs Turkey W (EuroVolley Women quarter-finals in Istanbul). ESPN site.api volleyball/womens-college-volleyball is NCAA. Those sides are never joined.
irregularities.effect_on_output: EuroVolley fixtures are scored only from the committed CEV tape. NCAA fixtures are scored only from ESPN. Internationals without a sourced tape are listed and SKIPPED.

irregularities.title: No free multi-book volleyball moneyline
irregularities.detail: ESPN NCAA volleyball on 2026-09-02 had oddsSeen false. OLBG HTML carries no structured prices. The prompt requires odds from at least two bookmakers.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Odds component marked missing; LIVE_CAP prevents HIGH confidence on a live card.

irregularities.title: Kills/blocks per set have no key-less feed
irregularities.detail: The attacking-quality block of the master prompt needs kills per set and blocks per set. ESPN scoreboard linescores are set points, not those rates.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Attacking quality scores 0 and is listed in missing[].

irregularities.title: Germany 3-0 Hungary 25 August has an incomplete set line
irregularities.detail: the-sports.org prints (25-17, 7-4) for a listed 3-0. The fifth-ball 7-4 cannot be a completed set.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Match counts as a Germany win for form.last5. Set-score components ignore it (setsIncomplete).

irregularities.title: Belgium vs Spain 22 August listing disagrees with the printed sets
irregularities.detail: Listed Belgium 3-2 with sets (15-25, 25-18, 25-23, 17-25, 8-15). The fifth set 8-15 would be a Spain win, i.e. 2-3.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Match omitted from the tape. Not invented.

irregularities.title: OLBG volleyball kickoff times are untrusted
irregularities.detail: U-02: OLBG printed 09:00 and 12:00 for the Istanbul quarter-finals. Wikipedia lists 16:00 and 19:00 local.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Calendar date comes from Wikipedia (3 September). startUtc is null.
